title: Agent Governance Specification
description:
A vocabulary for stating, in advance, what an autonomous agent is permitted to do, and for recording what was decided, whether the action was allowed or refused.

Existing AI governance addresses the model: what it was trained on, how it scores on evaluations, whether its outputs are toxic. None of that constrains what an agent may do with a payment API in reach. This specification addresses the action instead: the authority an agent holds, how that authority attenuates when delegated, the ordered checks an action is evaluated against, and the record produced either way.

Published unbranded under Apache 2.0 so that any engine, including a competitor's, may claim conformance to it.
